message.content:
The image is a magazine cover with a white background and red borders on the left and bottom. At the top, the large gray word "TEMPO" is centered above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." To the left, a red circular seal contains the number "46."

Text at the top reads: "KERETA RINGAN KURANG MODAL / WALI KOTA BEKASI: SAYA TAK PEDULI DISEBUT KAFIR." The central focus is the large, bold text "KPK GAWAT" in black and red. The letters "K" and "K" are black, while the middle "P" is red. The letter "P" appears fractured with a jagged, white starburst-shaped hole in its center. Inside this central void and along the cracked edges of the first "K" and "P," several small black human silhouettes are depicted. On the left "K," four figures stand or crouch on a jagged ledge. Within the "P," one silhouette appears to be falling or leaping through the central hole, while another crouches on a lower ledge.

Below, black text reads: "RENCANA KOMISI ANTIKORUPSI MEREKRUT PENYIDIK POLISI MENERBITKAN PRO-KONTRA. PEMBUSUKAN DARI DALAM?" At the bottom left, a barcode sits beside the date "3-9 APRIL 2017," the price "RP 45.000," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO."
